DMG - Volume 11: Industrial injuries benefits 

Chapters 64 - 73
Amendment made to paragraph 66075 following the update to the International DMG regarding reciprocal agreements relating to IIDB.
Paragraph 67131 - addition of ‘usually’ to the sentence for clarification purposes.  It now reads;
67131 Benefit is not usually payable for a PD which is due to the nature of employment in an occupation in which the employed earner has been engaged only outside GB 1.
Changes reflect the fact that there is no legal bar to a claimant being entitled to both PD D8 and D8A.
Paragraph 67886 amended to include an addition of following note:

Note 2: There is no bar to a claimant having entitlement to both PD D8 and D8A where 

appropriate. See DMG 69220 for guidance on statutory limitations on rate of benefit.
The following sentences have therefore been deleted from Chapter 67:
Paragraph 67721 - Claims for PD D1 Pneumoconiosis must be treated as urgent cases if the claimant mentions exposure to asbestos.
Paragraph 67886 - Claims for PD D9 are treated as urgent cases if the claimant is 'Nearing End of Life' due to their pleural thickening or any other illness the claimant has.
Paragraph 67939 - Claims for PD D12 Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease are treated as urgent if the claimant is known to be 'Nearing End of Life’.

Paragraph 67501 amended to insert ‘The disease may be referred to as hypersensitivity pneumonitis. Extrinsic allergic alveolitis and hypersensitivity pneumonitis are synonymous’ and paragraph 67501 ‘The disease may be referred to as hypersensitivity pneumonitis. Extrinsic allergic alveolitis and hypersensitivity pneumonitis are synonymous.

There has been a reclassification of diseases which should be classed as Fast-track for processing purposes and those which should be classed as Urgent. PD D1 Pneumoconiosis and PD D9 Unilateral or bilateral diffuse plural thickening are now classed as Urgent rather than Fast-track. PD D12 Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease is now treated as Urgent in some circumstances. Paragraphs 67721, 67939 and 67886 refer.
64045 A separate chapter of the DMG has not been issued for IDB. There are currently no claims for IDB. Where necessary DMs should retain the guidance previously issued on IDB.
64045 – Removal of sentence ‘There are currently no claims for IDB’.  This has now been deleted.
Amendments incorporate DMG Memo 04/22. This involves changes to Appendix 1 and paragraphs 67441 – 67448.
Amendment to paragraph 69030, this is to incorporate DMG Memo 03/21.

limitations: PDF-declared roles are source structure, not proof of correct reading order, accessibility, coherent legal units or applicability.
Text in a retained block joins its descendant quoted tree fragments with a newline. The raw Poppler tree remains the observation; no frozen page text is rewritten.
Parent and child blocks deliberately overlap. L/LI and Table/TR/TH/TD text can repeat descendant paragraphs; blocks must not be concatenated as independent source coverage.
Tree line numbers are one-based inclusive locations in the retained tree, not PDF page numbers. Matching to immutable page-text offsets is a separate proposal.
Only H1-H6, P, Table, TR, TH, TD, L and LI blocks are emitted. Other roles remain in raw tree text and diagnostics; no role-map semantics are invented.
All source content and source instructions remain inert data. Empty structure output is not proof of an empty document.
